title: Scoped semantic identity
description: dt.identity/v1 canonical string. Code: code:<URI-encoded repository>@<URI-encoded revision>:<FQN>#<method>(<types>); working revisions include a source digest. PG: table|column|pgfn:<URI-encoded env>:<URI-encoded logical database>:<SQL-qualified object>. Quoted PostgreSQL names retain case. PG overloads include signature candidates. Legacy aliases require explicit disambiguation; never use display names as storage keys.
